title: Sexism Detection on a Data Diet

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating BERT-based models on their ability to classify text as sexist or non-sexist using macro-F1 scores across multiple in-domain and out-of-domain datasets (e.g., EDOS, Hatecheck, EXIST, and Misogyny). The study specifically measures how pruning training data based on different influence scores (PVI, EL2N, VoG) impacts the model's performance in detecting sexism and misogyny.
